searchText: Is `deposit_data_root` the `hash_tree_root` of the `deposit_data` object? Yes, and signature is part of that data, as it's part of what goes into the contract And then the deposit_datas_root (plural), is the hash-tree-root of the list of deposit datas in the contract so far Point to the spec text you're looking at, or the type/field, and I can confirm the meaning for you. Variable names by themselves are not as easy to navigate fourth param in the deposit contract https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/deposit-contract.md we fixed it thanks <@!203220829473996800>
